breaks.summary: payment_method_types removed from Checkout Sessions, PaymentIntents and SetupIntents; requests including it return HTTP 400.

breaks.reason_not_codemod: Semantic: the fix is to request the field via expand, a decision about what the caller needs. Fixed only via the opt-in semantic_fixes module with confirm=True, never by the default codemod.
breaks.summary: billed_until on SubscriptionItem changed from returned-by-default to includable (only present when requested via expand). Code reading it directly gets an empty value silently.

breaks.reason_not_codemod: Out of scope for the default B1 codemod; fixed by the separate opt-in semantic_fixes module. One-way upgrade: works on stripe-python 16, breaks on 15.
breaks.summary: stripe.Reversal renamed to stripe.TransferReversal; old name raises AttributeError.

breaks.fix: Bump the pinned API version to 41.0 or later (no codemod: version string is a config decision).
breaks.summary: Salesforce Platform API versions 21.0-30.0 retired Summer '25; REST calls return HTTP 410:GONE. App pins v28.0.

breaks.fix: Migrate to the Lists v3 API (no codemod: endpoint path changes).
breaks.summary: HubSpot Contact Lists API (v1) sunset April 30, 2026; v1 Lists endpoints return HTTP 404.

breaks.fix: Migrate to the Twilio Conversations API (no codemod: different API).
breaks.summary: Twilio Programmable Chat API sunset July 25, 2022; migrate to Conversations. Mock models post-sunset calls as 410:GONE (Twilio named the date, not a status code).

breaks.fix: Use constructEvent for snapshot (v1) events and parseEventNotification for thin (v2.core.event) notifications (no codemod: call-site logic).
breaks.summary: stripe-node 21: constructEvent throws on a thin event and parseEventNotification throws on a snapshot event; before 21 the wrong parser returned silently. Verified live against real stripe@21.0.0 vs stripe@20.0.0.

controls.summary: POST /v1/customers request params identical in both specs.
stripe.Webhook.construct_event unchanged in stripe-python 15 -> 16 (verified live against stripe==16.0.0).
Salesforce API v60.0 is supported; query works.
HubSpot Lists v3 is the migration target; works.
Twilio Conversations v1 is the migration target; works.
Correct parser per event type works on stripe-node 21.

note: Curated registry of the 3 real breaks used by this sandbox. Each entry is sourced from Stripe's own changelog / SDK changelog (see 'source'). The detector verifies each entry against the real specs and the app code instead of trusting this file blindly: spec_diff entries must show up in the actual spec diff, and every entry must have a matching call site in app/. Added 2026-11-09 (expand/multi-api): S1, H1, T1, N1 are already-broken (counted in the GO verdict); S2 and H2 are upcoming warnings (counted separately, not in the GO denominator). Retirement/sunset/node entries are verified against the vendor's own docs/changelog plus a matching call site in app/ or node_app/; see detector/data/vendor_retirements.json and docs/MULTI_API_SOURCES.md.

upcoming.summary: Versions 31.0-40.0: supported now, deprecated and unsupported from Summer '27, RETIRED from Summer '28 (REST 410:GONE). App pins v35.0 as the upcoming-warning case.
Pipelines API V1 sunsets December 4, 2026; v1 endpoints stop responding after that date. Migrate to the 2026-03 or newer version.
